description: WRF error patterns and solutions for automated error recovery

patterns.action: Examine surrounding lines for specific error message

patterns.description: CFL criterion violation - time step too large for grid spacing
common_causes: Strong vertical motion in urban thermals
suggested_fixes: Reduce time_step (recommend: time_step = 6 × dx for d01)
patterns.autofix_strategy: Reduce time_step by 50% and increase w_damping

patterns.description: Fortran runtime error (often memory or array bound issues)
common_causes: Land surface input incompatible with num_land_cat

patterns.description: Segmentation fault - likely memory or input data issue
suggested_fixes: Check for disk space in run directory

patterns.description: WRF called FATAL subroutine - check preceding lines
suggested_fixes: Check namelist.input for missing required parameters
Verify met_em files cover the full simulation period

patterns.description: Too many meteorological fields in met_em files
suggested_fixes: Check Vtable matches downloaded data type
patterns.autofix_strategy: Set num_metgrid_levels to match available pressure levels

patterns.pattern: dx and dy must be positive
patterns.description: Invalid grid spacing values in namelist
RRTMG radiation error - often ozone/atmosphere data missing
suggested_fixes: Ensure ozone data in met_em files
Set o3input=0 to use climatological ozone
patterns.autofix_strategy: Add o3input=0 to namelist physics section if missing

patterns.description: Simulation time not found in met_em boundary files
suggested_fixes: Check start/end dates match met_em file times
Regenerate met_em files with correct date range

patterns.description: Land/water mask mismatch in input data
suggested_fixes: Check geogrid GEOGRID.TBL land use categories
Use consistent land use dataset in WPS
